Lovely family run restaurant that serves delicious Vietnamese food
May 2026 • Couples
We had such a wonderful experience at this charming little restaurant. It’s clearly a family-run place, and you can feel that warmth the moment you walk in, like being welcomed into someone’s home rather than just another table.

The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavour and clearly made with care and pride. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, and we found ourselves enjoying every single bite. On top of that, the prices were incredibly reasonable, which made the whole experience even better.

Its location was also perfect for us, just a short and easy walk from where we were staying, which made it such a convenient and relaxed choice for dinner.

All in all, a genuinely lovely spot with great food, kind people, and fantastic value. We’d happily return again and again.

Skip the main strip and come here instead
Mar 2026 • Couples
A delightful, family-run restaurant in Ninh Binh. It’s slightly outside of the main strip so is naturally quieter than other options, but for those willing to travel just 5 minutes more, you’ll find a gem.

It has the charm of a family home stay (his young daughter was finishing her homework on a table near us 🥹), and serves really great food.

The braised fish is excellent and the spring rolls were better than Tam Vi in Hanoi. The owner also gave us some hand picked bananas from his garden which was a lovely touch.

Bring your friends, it’s great.
